caption: Turquoise bays and small islands off Langkawi, seen from a mountain top
alt: A high view over green forested headlands, a small yacht marina and a turquoise sea dotted with wooded islets under white clouds
author: Jakub Michankow

caption: The Langkawi Sky Bridge, a curved walkway hung from a single pylon above the rainforest
alt: A curved steel footbridge with walkers, hung by cables from one tall green pylon over jungle-covered peaks, with the sea beyond
author: Engin Akyurt

caption: Pantai Cenang, the long sandy beach on Langkawi's west coast
alt: A wide pale sand beach with grey rocks, palm trees and calm turquoise water, with mountains on the far horizon
author: NickLubushko

caption: Masjid Al Hana, the town mosque of Kuah, Langkawi's main town
alt: A white mosque with golden domes and many slender minarets topped with onion domes, behind a paved forecourt under a blue sky
author: CEphoto, Uwe Aranas

caption: Limestone cliffs and mangroves along a river in Kilim Geoforest Park
alt: A tall rock cliff covered in trees rising from green water, with a line of mangrove trees running into the distance
author: Dcpeets
